what: How games move under the current rules, and under candidate rule changes.
setup: Openings -5,2, -5,3, -3,-2, -3,5, -2,-3, -2,5, 2,-5, 2,3, 3,-5, 3,2, 5,-3, 5,-2, -3,0, -3,3, 0,-3, 0,3, 3,-3, 3,0, -2,0, -2,2, 0,-2, 0,2, 2,-2, 2,0; the second player does whatever is better for them; every reply enumerated; both sides search to depth 3.
metric: "last lead change" is how far into the game the leader changed for the last time, averaged over games. A game decided early has a small number.

variants.name: current rules
variants.swapDecidedBy: a first pass over all 24 openings together: responder takes
